title: Roblox Plus Theme Identifiers JSON

themes.title: Roblox Plus Theme Identifiers
themes.description: This groups Roblox Plus Themes with their value in settings and actual class name.

setting.title: Setting Value
setting.description: The value that is set in Roblox's settings data. An example is NebulaDrift

class.title: Class Name
class.description: The CSS class name that the theme uses. An example is nebula-drift-theme
